items.name: Core Factory V3
items.title: Core Factory V3
items.description:
Core Factory V3

Build, automate, connect, and manage your workflows from one extensible local-first platform.

Core Factory V3 is a modular automation and application platform designed to bring tools, processing engines, background services, workflows, and connected operations into one unified environment.

Instead of relying on separate applications for every task, Core Factory provides a structured foundation where specialized Engines, Plugins, and Node Services can work together while remaining independently installable and maintainable.

Run Core Factory as your personal automation workspace, extend it with new capabilities, or connect multiple Core installations when your workflow grows beyond a single computer.

Whether you're a creator, developer, technical professional, small business, team, or organization, Core Factory V3 provides a flexible foundation that can grow from everyday local automation into connected multi-computer workflows.

Key Features
Personal Workspace

Use Core Factory as a private local platform for your everyday tools and automation.

Manage:

Engines
Plugins
Pipelines
Jobs
Files
Processing workflows
Installed components

Your personal environment remains independent and can continue operating without requiring a remote server.

Engine System

Extend Core Factory with reusable processing Engines.

Engines follow a simple model:

Input → Execution → Output

They can provide capabilities such as:

Media processing
File operations
Data processing
Speech processing
Capture and recording
Conversion
Analysis
Automation utilities

Install only the capabilities you need and reuse them across different workflows.

Plugin System

Add complete tools and long-running services through Plugins.

Plugins can provide:

Productivity applications
Automation services
Monitoring tools
Content workflows
Business utilities
Background processing
Specialized user interfaces

Each Plugin operates as an independent extension while using the common Core Factory infrastructure.

Node Services

Core Factory V3 introduces Node Services, a new extension layer for shared and connected workflows.

Node Services allow a Core Host to provide specialized services to authorized users or other Core installations.

They can be used to build:

Shared task systems
Team workflows
File services
Reporting systems
Department operations
Internal business applications
Custom organization workflows

Business-specific functionality stays inside the Node Service instead of being hard-coded into Core Factory.

Core-to-Core Connectivity

Connect one Core Factory installation to one or multiple Core Hosts.

Connected users can access the Node Services available to their accounts directly from their own Core interface.

Each connection maintains its own:

Account
Session
Permissions
Services
Files
Jobs
Results

This allows Core Factory to grow naturally from a single-computer application into a connected environment.

Host Mode

Turn any Core Factory installation into a Host when shared services are needed.

Host Mode provides the infrastructure for:

Accounts
Authentication
Permissions
Node Services
User workspaces
Remote tasks
Files
Jobs
Results

Personal Core functionality remains separated from the services exposed to connected users.

Multi-Core Ready

Core Factory V3 is not limited to a traditional one-client, one-server architecture.

A Core can maintain multiple independent Host connections while also operating locally.

This makes it possible to create flexible environments such as:

Personal Core → Company Core

Office Core → Processing Core

Team Core → Shared Service Core

or larger networks involving multiple independent Core installations.

Role & Permission Foundation

Connected services can control what each account is allowed to access or perform.

Node Services can define their own permissions for actions such as:

Create
View
Update
Submit
Approve
Execute
Manage
Audit

This provides a foundation for building applications for teams and organizations without exposing Core administration.

Account-Scoped Data

Remote work can remain associated with the account and service that created it.

Tasks, files, jobs, and results can therefore stay organized within their correct Host context.

This provides a clean foundation for shared systems while keeping Personal Core workloads separate.

Pipeline & Job Management

Build repeatable processing workflows using Core Factory Engines.

Core manages execution infrastructure including:

Job creation
Worker execution
Progress
Cancellation
History
Results
Pipeline processing

Complex processing capabilities can therefore be reused instead of rebuilt inside every application.

Modular Marketplace

Core Factory uses a modular ecosystem where capabilities can be distributed independently.

The Marketplace supports:

Engines
Plugins
Node Services
Core Platform releases

Install new functionality without turning the Core itself into a large collection of hard-coded features.

Controlled Package Installation

Core Factory provides a structured installation and update lifecycle for ecosystem components.

The platform supports foundations for:

Package verification
Signed releases
Integrity validation
Version compatibility
Installation records
Updates
Licensing
Controlled restart and installation

This helps keep the Core stable while individual ecosystem components continue evolving.

Local-First Architecture

Core Factory is designed around local ownership.

You can begin with a single computer and local workflows without requiring complex server infrastructure.

When additional computers or users are needed, the same platform can expand through Host and Connected capabilities.

There is no need to replace your original Personal Core workflow just because your environment grows.

Typical Use Cases

Core Factory V3 can provide the foundation for:

Personal automation
Media production
Content workflows
File processing
AI-assisted workflows
Technical productivity
Data processing
Repetitive office operations
Small business workflows
Team task management
Internal company tools
Shared processing services
Multi-computer workflows
Private automation networks
Custom Node Service applications
Built to Grow With Your Workflow

Start simple:

Core Factory → Engine → Job

Add applications:

Core Factory → Plugins

Build automated workflows:

Core Factory → Pipelines → Engines

When collaboration becomes necessary:

Core Factory → Host → Node Services

And when multiple workstations are involved:

Core ↔ Core ↔ Core

The same platform can evolve with your requirements without forcing every user into distributed infrastructure from the beginning.

Three Extension Layers

Core Factory V3 keeps its ecosystem intentionally modular.

Engine

Reusable execution capability.

Plugin

Local application or background service.

Node Service

Shared service for connected users and Core installations.

Each layer has a clear responsibility, helping keep applications maintainable as the ecosystem grows.

Designed for More Than One Industry

Core Factory is not a restaurant system, hotel system, office system, media application, or ERP.

It is the infrastructure on which specialized applications can be built.

The same platform can support completely different workflows by installing different Engines, Plugins, and Node Services.

This allows developers and businesses to build what they need without changing the Core itself.

Perfect For
Individual professionals
Content creators
Developers
Engineers
Technical teams
Small businesses
Offices
Production teams
Automation enthusiasts
Organizations building private internal workflows
Anyone who wants reusable tools instead of disconnected applications
Why Core Factory V3?

Most automation tools solve one specific problem.

As workflows grow, users often end up managing separate applications, scripts, folders, processing tools, services, and computers with no common foundation connecting them.

Core Factory takes a different approach.

It provides one extensible platform where processing capabilities, applications, workflows, shared services, and connected computers can evolve together while remaining modular.

Start with the tools you need today.

Add Engines when you need new processing capabilities.

Add Plugins when you need new applications.

Add Node Services when you need shared workflows.

Connect additional Core installations when your operation grows.

Start local. Extend freely. Connect when needed. Build your own ecosystem with Core Factory V3.

items.name: Screen Recorder Engine V2
items.title: Screen Recorder Engine V2
items.description:
Screen Recorder Engine V2

Capture your screen with high performance, automation, and pipeline-ready output.

Screen Recorder Engine is a professional screen capture engine for Core Factory V2, designed to record your desktop, applications, or selected workflows into high-quality video files. Whether you're creating tutorials, documenting software, recording gameplay, capturing automated tests, or generating AI datasets, the engine delivers reliable recording with seamless automation.

Built for both manual and automated workflows, Screen Recorder Engine integrates directly with Core Factory V2 Pipelines, allowing recorded videos to flow into downstream processing without manual intervention.



Key Features

High-Performance Screen Recording

Record your screen smoothly with configurable capture settings.

Supported features include:





Full desktop recording



High frame-rate capture



Configurable FPS



Adjustable output quality



Efficient video encoding



Low-overhead screen capture

Designed for long recording sessions while maintaining stable performance.



Flexible Recording Modes

Choose the recording workflow that best fits your project.





Manual recording



One-time recording



Fixed-duration recording



Scheduled recording



Automated pipeline execution

Perfect for both interactive use and unattended automation.



Custom Capture Configuration

Fine-tune recording behavior with configurable settings such as:





Frames per second (FPS)



Output resolution



Video quality



Output filename templates



Recording duration



Output directory



Automatic overwrite policy

Create recordings optimized for tutorials, demonstrations, AI datasets, or production workflows.



Organized Output Management

Automatically generate structured video files with customizable filenames.

Features include:





Timestamp-based filenames



Automatic output folder creation



Optional overwrite protection



Structured execution reports



Processing logs for automation

Every recording is organized and ready for downstream processing.



Automation Ready

Screen Recorder Engine integrates seamlessly with Core Factory V2 Pipelines.

Recorded videos can be sent directly to engines such as:





Video Processing



AI Video Analysis



OCR



Speech-to-Text



Subtitle Generation



Content Summarization



Media Conversion



Upload Automation

No manual exporting or file management is required.



Typical Use Cases





Software tutorials



Product demonstrations



Online course creation



Gameplay recording



Automated UI testing



Bug reproduction



AI training datasets



Technical documentation



Workflow recording



Internal team training



Reliable Long-Running Recording

Designed for dependable automation and production environments.

Features include:





Progress monitoring



Cancellation support



Stable worker-process execution



Structured execution logs



Machine-readable reports



Reliable operation during long recording sessions



System Requirements





Core Factory V2



Windows desktop environment



DirectX-compatible graphics hardware



Screen capture runtime (DXcam/OpenCV)



Why Choose Screen Recorder Engine?

Traditional screen recorders are built primarily for manual recording.

Screen Recorder Engine is designed for automation. It combines reliable, high-performance screen capture with scheduling, structured outputs, and direct integration into larger workflows.

Whether you're producing training content, documenting software, building AI datasets, or automating repetitive recording tasks, Screen Recorder Engine provides a scalable and professional solution within the Core Factory V2 ecosystem.



Perfect For





Content Creators



Software Developers



QA & Testing Teams



AI Developers



Technical Trainers



Educators



Businesses



Anyone who needs automated, high-quality screen recording

Capture your screen once—or automate it forever—with Screen Recorder Engine V2.

items.name: Video CTA Overlay Engine V2
items.title: Video CTA Overlay Engine V2
items.description:
# Video CTA Overlay Engine V2

**Boost engagement by adding YouTube-style video call-to-action overlays directly into your videos—automatically and at scale.**

Video CTA Overlay Engine is a professional video branding engine for **Core Factory V2** that overlays a promotional video, title, and description onto your videos at precise moments during playback.

Inspired by the modern in-video recommendation cards used by platforms like YouTube, this engine helps promote products, channels, courses, websites, or related videos without interrupting the viewing experience.

Built for automation, it supports batch processing, customizable layouts, animations, timeline control, and seamless integration with Core Factory V2 Pipelines.

---

# Key Features

## Dynamic Video CTA Overlay

Embed a secondary promotional video directly into your main video.

Unlike static watermarks, the CTA remains fully animated and plays during the specified time range.

Perfect for promoting:

* Related videos
* Products
* Online courses
* Websites
* Channels
* Services
* Mobile apps

---

## Professional CTA Panel

Display a modern information panel alongside the CTA video.

The panel supports:

* CTA title
* Multi-line description
* Custom fonts
* Adjustable colors
* Opacity control
* Responsive sizing

Create clean promotional overlays that look natural instead of distracting.

---

## Multiple Layout Modes

Choose the presentation style that best fits your content.

Supported layouts include:

* Bottom Left
* Bottom Right
* Video Only

Designed to avoid overlapping with common social platform controls while maximizing visibility.

---

## Timeline Control

Display your CTA exactly when it matters most.

Configure:

* Overlay start time
* Display duration
* CTA source start offset
* Loop CTA video
* Animation duration

Perfect for showing promotions near the end of a video or at strategic engagement points.

---

## Smooth Animations

Make your overlays feel polished and professional.

Available animation effects include:

* Fade
* Slide Up
* Instant Display

Animations improve viewer experience without disrupting the main content.

---

## Fully Customizable Design

Control every visual element of your CTA.

Customize:

* Panel background color
* Panel transparency
* CTA video size
* Panel dimensions
* Bottom safe margin
* Side padding
* Video-to-text spacing
* Title color
* Description color
* Font sizes
* Maximum text length

The engine automatically scales the layout to match different video resolutions.

---

## High-Quality Video Encoding

Powered by FFmpeg for production-ready output.

Encoding options include:

* H.264
* H.265 (HEVC)
* Adjustable CRF quality
* Multiple encoding presets
* Overwrite control

Deliver professional-quality videos while balancing file size and encoding speed.

---

## Batch Processing

Apply CTA overlays to entire video libraries automatically.

Features include:

* Recursive folder scanning
* Preserve folder hierarchy
* Continue on error
* Progress reporting
* Structured execution reports

Perfect for processing hundreds or thousands of videos with minimal manual effort.

---

## Automation Ready

Video CTA Overlay Engine integrates seamlessly with **Core Factory V2 Pipelines**.

Typical workflows include:

* Media Transcode
* Aspect Ratio Conversion
* Watermark Processing
* Subtitle Generation
* Video Compression
* Social Media Publishing
* Upload Automation

Automatically insert promotional CTAs before videos are published across multiple platforms.

---

# Typical Use Cases

* Promote your latest YouTube video
* Recommend related content
* Advertise products or services
* Display website information
* Promote online courses
* Increase channel subscriptions
* Cross-promote social media accounts
* Build branded marketing videos

---

# Reliable Production Workflow

Designed for large-scale video automation.

Features include:

* Worker-process execution
* Progress monitoring
* Cancellation support
* Structured JSON reports
* Continue-on-error processing
* Folder structure preservation
* Predictable batch execution

Whether processing dozens or thousands of videos, the engine delivers consistent and professional results.

---

# System Requirements

* Core Factory V2
* FFmpeg
* Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)

---

# Why Choose Video CTA Overlay Engine?

Traditional video editors require manually adding promotional overlays to every video—a repetitive and time-consuming task.

Video CTA Overlay Engine automates this entire workflow by inserting animated CTA videos and professional information panels exactly where you want them. It helps creators and businesses promote additional content, increase viewer engagement, and strengthen branding without manual editing.

Whether you're managing YouTube channels, educational platforms, product launches, or automated content pipelines, this engine transforms every video into an opportunity for greater audience interaction.

---

## Perfect For

* YouTubers
* Content Creators
* Online Educators
* Marketing Teams
* Media Agencies
* Businesses
* AI Video Production Pipelines
* Anyone creating branded video content

Turn every video into a smarter marketing asset with Video CTA Overlay Engine V2.

items.name: Watermark Media Engine V2
items.title: Watermark Media Engine V2
items.description:
# Watermark Media Engine V2

**Protect your content and strengthen your brand with professional logo and text watermarks for both images and videos.**

Watermark Media Engine is a professional branding engine for **Core Factory V2** that automatically applies image logos and text watermarks to photos and videos in batch. Whether you're publishing content to YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, or building a media production pipeline, this engine helps ensure every file carries your visual identity.

Designed for automation, it supports recursive folder processing, customizable watermark styles, high-quality rendering, and seamless integration with Core Factory V2 Pipelines.

---

# Key Features

## Logo Watermarks

Apply your company logo or brand mark to every image and video automatically.

Supported features include:

* PNG, WebP, and common image formats
* Adjustable logo size
* Custom logo opacity
* Multiple placement positions
* Batch processing
* High-quality rendering

Perfect for protecting original content while increasing brand visibility.

---

## Text Watermarks

Add professional text overlays to both images and videos.

Customize every aspect of the watermark:

* Custom text
* Font selection
* Font size
* Font color
* Text opacity
* Stroke outline
* Shadow effects

Whether displaying your company name, website, copyright notice, or campaign message, text watermarks remain sharp and readable across different media formats.

---

## Flexible Positioning

Choose exactly where your watermark appears.

Supported positions include:

* Top Left
* Top Center
* Top Right
* Center Left
* Center
* Center Right
* Bottom Left
* Bottom Center
* Bottom Right

This flexibility allows branding that complements your content without distracting viewers.

---

## Process Images and Videos Together

Unlike tools limited to a single media type, Watermark Media Engine handles both images and videos within the same workflow.

Supported formats include:

### Images

* JPG
* JPEG
* PNG
* WebP
* BMP

### Videos

* MP4
* MOV
* AVI
* MKV
* WebM

This makes it ideal for mixed media libraries and multi-platform publishing.

---

## Batch Processing

Apply watermarks to hundreds or thousands of files automatically.

Features include:

* Recursive folder scanning
* Preserve folder structure
* Continue on error
* Overwrite control
* Progress reporting

Large media collections can be processed with a single job.

---

## Professional Rendering

Built using FFmpeg and Pillow to produce clean, high-quality output.

Features include:

* Sharp logo rendering
* Anti-aliased text
* Adjustable transparency
* Text outlines
* Shadow rendering
* Consistent results across different resolutions

Designed for production-quality branding without manual editing.

---

## Automation Ready

Watermark Media Engine integrates seamlessly with **Core Factory V2 Pipelines**.

Typical downstream workflows include:

* Media Transcode
* Aspect Ratio Conversion
* Subtitle Generation
* Video Compression
* Upload Automation
* Social Media Publishing
* Archive Management

Automatically watermark content before publishing or distribution without additional manual steps.

---

# Typical Use Cases

* Brand YouTube videos
* Add logos to TikTok and Instagram content
* Protect digital photography
* Watermark product images
* Add copyright notices
* Prepare marketing assets
* Publish branded training videos
* Build automated media production workflows

---

# Reliable Batch Processing

Designed for professional media production.

Features include:

* Worker-process execution
* Progress monitoring
* Cancellation support
* Structured JSON reports
* Continue-on-error processing
* Folder hierarchy preservation
* Predictable and repeatable output

Whether processing dozens or thousands of files, the engine delivers reliable results with minimal supervision.

---

# System Requirements

* Core Factory V2
* FFmpeg
* Pillow
* Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)

---

# Why Choose Watermark Media Engine?

Adding watermarks manually is repetitive, time-consuming, and difficult to maintain across large media libraries.

Watermark Media Engine automates the entire branding process, allowing you to apply consistent logos and text overlays across images and videos while maintaining high visual quality.

Whether you're protecting copyrighted work, reinforcing your brand, or preparing media for large-scale publishing, this engine provides a fast, reliable, and production-ready watermarking solution.

---

## Perfect For

* Content Creators
* YouTubers
* Social Media Managers
* Marketing Teams
* Photographers
* Video Editors
* Media Agencies
* Businesses publishing branded content

Protect your content. Strengthen your brand. Automate your watermarking with Watermark Media Engine V2.

items.name: Company Tasks Node Service
items.title: Company Tasks Node Service
items.description:
Company Tasks Node Service

Turn Core Factory V3 into a simple shared workspace for assigning work, coordinating teams, submitting reports, and managing company data across connected Core users.

Company Tasks Node Service is a reference business service for Core Factory V3, designed to demonstrate how organizations can build structured workflows on top of the Core-to-Core architecture.

Instead of sharing tasks, documents, reports, and work updates across separate messaging apps, spreadsheets, and folders, Company Tasks provides a centralized service hosted by one Core Factory Host.

Managers can create and assign work, while staff connect through their own Core Factory instance to view assigned tasks, update progress, upload supporting files, and submit completed work.

All business data remains managed by the Host and separated by account, permissions, and service context.

Key Features
Manager & Staff Roles

Built around two simple business roles:

Manager

Create and assign tasks
Manage department work
Review staff submissions
Track task progress
Access permitted reports and files

Staff

View assigned tasks
Update task status
Add work notes
Upload supporting documents
Submit completed work for review

This provides a clean foundation for expanding into more advanced company roles later.

Department-Based Workflow

Organize work by department instead of keeping every task in one shared list.

Company Tasks can be used for departments such as:

Administration
Operations
Engineering
Sales
Accounting
Content
Support

Each department can gradually develop its own workflow while still operating inside the same Core Factory Host.

Centralized Task Management

Managers can create structured tasks containing information such as:

Task title
Description
Assigned user
Department
Priority
Due date
Status
Notes
Supporting files

Staff receive the work through their connected Core environment and can update it without accessing Host administration.

Work Submission

Staff can submit completed work directly through the Node Service.

A submission can include:

Completion status
Work notes
Reports
Documents
Supporting files
Result information

This creates a clear flow:

Manager → Assign → Staff → Work → Submit → Manager Review

Service-Scoped Files

Company documents can remain associated with the Node Service instead of being scattered across personal folders.

Files can be organized around:

Accounts
Departments
Tasks
Submissions
Reports

This also establishes the foundation for future document workflows and company knowledge systems.

Core-to-Core Collaboration

Company Tasks is designed for the Core Factory V3 Connected architecture.

A Host Core publishes the Node Service.

Other Core Factory installations connect using authorized accounts and receive only the services and capabilities available to them.

This allows multiple Core installations to work with the same company system while keeping Personal Core environments independent.

Host-Owned Business Data

Business data is stored and managed on the Host.

Connected users operate against their authorized Host context rather than creating disconnected copies of company data.

This provides a foundation for:

Centralized company records
Account ownership
Permission control
Department separation
Manager oversight
Future audit capabilities
Permission-Based Access

Company Tasks is designed around controlled access rather than exposing the entire Host Core.

Users only interact with the Node Service capabilities granted to their account.

This architecture can later expand into:

Custom roles
Department managers
Supervisors
Administrators
Read-only users
Cross-department permissions
Audit roles
Automation Ready

Company Tasks runs inside the Core Factory ecosystem and can evolve alongside Engines, Plugins, and other Node Services.

Future business workflows can combine tasks with Core capabilities such as:

File processing
Document generation
Notifications
Scheduled reminders
Data analysis
Reporting
AI processing
Workflow automation

Complex processing can remain reusable at the Core Engine layer while the Node Service focuses on company-specific business logic.

Typical Use Cases

Company Tasks can serve as a starting point for:

Small business task management
Internal company operations
Department coordination
Staff work assignment
Daily work reporting
Document submission
Manager approval workflows
Engineering teams
Construction companies
Restaurants and service businesses
Small manufacturing teams
Administrative offices
Multi-computer company environments
Built for Core Factory V3

Company Tasks is more than a standalone task manager.

It is a reference implementation of the Core Factory V3 Node Service architecture:

Personal Core → Host Core → Account & Permissions → Node Service → Business Data

It demonstrates how a Core Factory installation can evolve from a personal automation platform into shared infrastructure for teams and organizations.

Why Company Tasks?

Traditional small-business workflows often grow around messaging applications, spreadsheets, shared folders, and manual reporting.

Company Tasks provides a structured alternative while remaining intentionally simple.

The Host owns the business data.
Managers organize the work.
Staff connect through their own Core.
Permissions define what each user can access.
Node Services define the business workflow.

And Core Factory provides the infrastructure underneath.

Assign work. Connect your team. Centralize company data. Build your business workflows on Core Factory V3.

items.name: Media Library Plugin V2
items.title: Media Library Plugin V2
items.description:
# Media Library Plugin V2

**Browse, preview, and organize access to thousands of images, audio files, and videos—all from one media library.**

Media Library Plugin is a lightweight media browsing and playback plugin for Core Factory V2, designed to help you explore large collections of media files without manually navigating through countless folders.

Simply select a parent folder and Media Library automatically scans its subfolders, detects supported media files, and organizes them into three dedicated libraries:

**Images · Audio · Videos**

Instead of repeatedly opening folders, switching between media players, or searching through deeply nested directories, Media Library gives you one centralized interface for browsing and previewing your entire media collection.

Whether you manage video production assets, music and voice files, image libraries, downloaded stock media, project resources, or AI-generated content, Media Library makes finding and reviewing your files faster and easier.

## Key Features

### Recursive Media Scanning

Select one parent folder and let Media Library scan the entire directory structure automatically.

The plugin detects media files across nested folders and groups them into dedicated categories:

* Images
* Audio
* Videos

No need to manually add individual folders or files.

Your original files remain in their existing locations—the plugin simply provides a convenient way to browse and preview them.

### Image Library

Browse large image collections directly inside Core Factory.

Features include:

* Image file list
* Search and filtering
* Sort options
* Large image preview
* Previous / Next navigation
* Current position indicator
* File information
* Relative path display

Move quickly through hundreds or thousands of images without repeatedly opening files from Windows Explorer.

### Audio Library

Turn folders containing music, voice recordings, sound effects, podcasts, or generated audio into an easy-to-browse audio library.

Features include:

* Audio file browser
* Built-in audio player
* Search and sorting
* Previous / Next navigation
* Single or playlist-oriented browsing
* Repeat mode controls
* File information and location

Perfect for reviewing voice generation outputs, music libraries, sound effects, recordings, and other audio assets.

### Video Library

Browse and preview video collections directly inside the Core Factory interface.

Features include:

* Video file browser
* Integrated video preview
* Search and sorting
* Previous / Next navigation
* Single or playlist-oriented browsing
* Repeat mode controls
* File information
* Relative path tracking

This makes it much easier to review large folders of raw footage, stock media, generated videos, processed clips, and project assets.

### Search & Sort

Large media libraries can contain thousands of files.

Media Library provides tools to quickly narrow down the collection and locate the content you need.

Browse and organize results using options such as:

* File name
* Modified date
* File size
* Media type

Search and navigation operate directly on the scanned library for faster media discovery.

### Non-Destructive Browsing

Media Library is designed primarily as a browser and preview tool.

Scanning does not require reorganizing your original media folders.

Your existing directory structure remains intact, making the plugin suitable for established media archives and production workflows.

### Manual Scan & Refresh

Media Library does not continuously monitor your filesystem in the background.

Scanning is user-controlled.

Choose your library folder and refresh the media index whenever needed.

This keeps the plugin lightweight while avoiding unnecessary background filesystem activity.

### Large Media Collections

Media Library is designed for users who maintain large collections of production assets.

A single parent folder may contain media spread across many projects and subfolders.

Instead of navigating each folder individually, Media Library provides one unified view across the entire directory tree.

### Core Factory V2 Integration

Media Library Plugin is built for the Core Factory V2 ecosystem.

It follows the Core Factory plugin lifecycle and runs as a managed plugin service while keeping media scanning user-triggered.

The plugin is designed for Core Factory V2.0.2 compatibility and integrates naturally with the existing Core plugin interface.

## Typical Use Cases

* Video production libraries
* Stock footage collections
* Image asset libraries
* Music collections
* Sound effect libraries
* Voice-over archives
* AI-generated media
* YouTube production assets
* Short-form video production
* Social media content libraries
* Project media folders
* Downloaded media collections
* Photography archives
* Training datasets
* Creative production resources

## Why Choose Media Library Plugin?

Media production often creates thousands of files distributed across many folders.

Finding the right image, listening to multiple audio files, or reviewing video clips can quickly become repetitive when every file must be opened manually.

Media Library turns one parent folder into a centralized media browser.

Scan once, then move between Images, Audio, and Videos from one organized interface.

Search your collection, preview files, move forward and backward through results, and quickly identify the media you need without constantly leaving Core Factory.

It is especially useful for workflows where media is continuously downloaded, generated, processed, or reused across multiple projects.

## Perfect For

* Content Creators
* Video Editors
* YouTubers
* Social Media Teams
* AI Content Creators
* Photographers
* Audio Producers
* Media Production Teams
* Marketing Teams
* Digital Asset Managers
* Core Factory Users
* Anyone managing large local media collections

## Core Factory Compatibility

**Plugin:** Media Library
**Version:** 1.0.2
**Platform:** Core Factory V2
**Baseline:** Core Factory V2.0.2
**Category:** Media

**Scan once. Browse everything. Preview your entire media library from one place with Media Library Plugin V2.**

items.name: Workspace Plugin V2
items.title: Workspace Plugin V2
items.description:
Workspace Plugin V2

Manage projects, reusable work libraries, and Excel-ready labour lists—all in one organized workspace.

Workspace Plugin is a professional productivity plugin for Core Factory V2, designed to centralize project management, technical documentation, reusable labour data, and quantity calculations into a single workspace.

Instead of juggling spreadsheets, folders, notes, and documents across multiple applications, Workspace Plugin gives you one structured environment where everything stays organized, reusable, and easy to manage.

Whether you're an engineer, contractor, content creator, technical team, or business owner, Workspace Plugin helps streamline daily operations while reducing repetitive work.

Key Features
Workspace Management

Create and organize multiple independent workspaces.

Each workspace can contain its own:

Tasks
Notes
Activities
Reminders
Attachments
Labour Data
Labour Lists

Keep every project isolated, organized, and easy to maintain.

Labour Data Library

Build reusable libraries of work items that can be used across unlimited projects.

Each Labour Data entry may include:

Item information
Descriptions
Images
Attachments
Structured tables
Materials
Labour quantities
Units of measurement

Create once and reuse whenever needed.

Labour List Builder

Generate complete labour or quantity lists by combining existing Labour Data.

Features include:

Select multiple labour templates
Reuse the same template multiple times
Quantity coefficient for each item
Automatic quantity multiplication
Automatic aggregation of duplicate rows
Live calculation preview

Perfect for construction estimates, engineering quantities, and repetitive project planning.

Excel Export

Export labour lists into clean, professional Excel spreadsheets.

Automatically generate:

Quantity summaries
Labour schedules
Material lists
Project reports

Reduce manual spreadsheet editing while improving consistency.

Task & Activity Management

Track work progress inside every workspace.

Features include:

Task management
Activity history
Notes
Reminders
Status tracking

Everything stays linked to the correct workspace for better organization.

File Attachments

Attach supporting documents directly to projects.

Supported examples include:

Drawings
Photos
PDFs
Office documents
Videos
Reference files

All attachments remain organized with the related workspace.

Automation Ready

Workspace Plugin integrates naturally with the Core Factory V2 ecosystem.

Generated Excel files and structured project data can be used alongside other plugins and automation pipelines, making it easy to extend your workflow as projects grow.

Typical Use Cases
Construction quantity takeoff
Bill of Quantities (BOQ)
Engineering project management
Installation planning
Technical documentation
Asset organization
Internal business operations
Reusable work libraries

Workspace Plugin V2

Manage projects, reusable work libraries, and Excel-ready labour lists—all in one organized workspace.

Workspace Plugin is a professional productivity plugin for Core Factory V2, designed to centralize project management, technical documentation, reusable labour data, and quantity calculations into a single workspace.

Instead of juggling spreadsheets, folders, notes, and documents across multiple applications, Workspace Plugin gives you one structured environment where everything stays organized, reusable, and easy to manage.

Whether you're an engineer, contractor, content creator, technical team, or business owner, Workspace Plugin helps streamline daily operations while reducing repetitive work.

Key Features
Workspace Management

Create and organize multiple independent workspaces.

Each workspace can contain its own:

Tasks
Notes
Activities
Reminders
Attachments
Labour Data
Labour Lists

Keep every project isolated, organized, and easy to maintain.

Labour Data Library

Build reusable libraries of work items that can be used across unlimited projects.

Each Labour Data entry may include:

Item information
Descriptions
Images
Attachments
Structured tables
Materials
Labour quantities
Units of measurement

Create once and reuse whenever needed.

Labour List Builder

Generate complete labour or quantity lists by combining existing Labour Data.

Features include:

Select multiple labour templates
Reuse the same template multiple times
Quantity coefficient for each item
Automatic quantity multiplication
Automatic aggregation of duplicate rows
Live calculation preview

Perfect for construction estimates, engineering quantities, and repetitive project planning.

Excel Export

Export labour lists into clean, professional Excel spreadsheets.

Automatically generate:

Quantity summaries
Labour schedules
Material lists
Project reports

Reduce manual spreadsheet editing while improving consistency.

Task & Activity Management

Track work progress inside every workspace.

Features include:

Task management
Activity history
Notes
Reminders
Status tracking

Everything stays linked to the correct workspace for better organization.

File Attachments

Attach supporting documents directly to projects.

Supported examples include:

Drawings
Photos
PDFs
Office documents
Videos
Reference files

All attachments remain organized with the related workspace.

Automation Ready

Workspace Plugin integrates naturally with the Core Factory V2 ecosystem.

Generated Excel files and structured project data can be used alongside other plugins and automation pipelines, making it easy to extend your workflow as projects grow.

Typical Use Cases
Construction quantity takeoff
Bill of Quantities (BOQ)
Engineering project management
Installation planning
Technical documentation
Asset organization
Internal business operations
